Team — looping you in on OptiMax's request to add 8 GPUs mid-term. Key asks: pricing for prorated add vs. blended rate, throughput guarantee for their pool, and a one-time credit request tied to a Q4 incident.

My read: customer values predictable unit cost and the SLA story (they're hitting launch timelines). They're price-sensitive vs. spinning up cloud GPUs. We should give two clear options and a limited, conditional credit. 

Items to decide:
- pricing math: propose Option A (prorated add at 85% of list per-GPU rate) vs Option B (move up to next commit tier with blended discount)
- discount floor: max 10% concession on net ARR for mid-term uplifts unless exec approval
- SLA: offer a throughput SLO for the dedicated pool (example: baseline throughput 400k tokens/minute; if we miss sustained throughput >5% below baseline for 24h, we provide service credit up to $25k)

Marcus — can you confirm whether 400k tokens/minute baseline is realistic for their current model mix? David — any capacity constraints if we push 8 additional GPUs in us-west?

I'll draft a one-page proposal and include a formal quote.

Thanks,
Soojin

All — based on usage patterns and Marcus's feedback (see inline), here are two firm options to present. Attaching a draft quote workbook.

Option 1 (Top-up, keeps original term)
- +8 A100-equivalent GPUs for remainder of term (~9 months)
- Prorated at 82.5% of current per-GPU committed unit price (blended to reflect existing commit)
- No term reset; volume discounts unchanged
- No long-term credit; one-time implementation fee waived

Option 2 (Tier upgrade, resets term)
- Move up to 48xA100-equivalent commit (adds 16 total; covers +8 now + headroom)
- 12-month reset, net 12% discount on committed units versus current pricing (applies to full new commit)
- One-time credit: $25,000 service credit applied on next invoice if they sign within 2 weeks

SLA/Throughput (both options)
- Baseline throughput guarantee: 400k tokens/minute for their pool (p95 throughput across their routes)
- If p95 throughput falls below baseline for >24 continuous hours due to Redwood infrastructure, we offer service credit up to $25k (capped)

Notes: finance has visibility on the pricing workbook. Attaching: Dedicated_Pricing_Quote_OptiMax_v2.xlsx. I'll prepare Commit_Change_Form.pdf for signature.

-Neha
